title: WhatsApp Fixes Flaw Uncovered While Disrupting Scam Campaign
description: CVE-2026-23871 is a low-impact vulnerability in WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business for Android prior to version 2.26.17.4. It involves incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs, which could allow an attacker to cause a target device to reveal its IP information when rendering a crafted Click to WhatsApp ad-reply message. The flaw was discovered by WhatsApp's security team during disruption of a scam campaign and may have been exploited to make scam messages appear more credible. WhatsApp has patched this vulnerability.
